## RatifierInfo interface

Classification of the ratifier route for a maker account.

Put `ratifier` on each new `Offer.create` call for this maker. Use `type` to decide whether the tree later needs an Ecrecover signature or a Setter root approval before payload encoding.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface RatifierInfo
```

## Example


```ts
import type { RatifierInfo } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const info: RatifierInfo = {
  type: "ecrecover",
  ratifier: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001",
};
```
